$comment: Commands bin/vshell-helper probes with shutil.which() that are deliberately
NOT declared as feature dependencies, and why. Nothing reads this at runtime;
it exists so an audit can tell a deliberate exclusion from drift, and so the
automated check tracked in VGS-33 has an allow-list to compare the probe sites
against. Adding a probe for a new command means declaring it under "features"
`sudo` is absent on purpose: VGS-11 declares it under a sudo-toggle group.
undeclared.vshell: Self-reference: resolves the CLI's own path.
undeclared.quickshell: Alternative binary name for the already-declared `qs`.
undeclared.start-hyprland: Optional session wrapper in the greeter launch path; falls back to `Hyprland` directly.
undeclared.dbus-run-session: Wraps the file manager when generating committed theme previews. Repo tooling, not a runtime feature.
undeclared.nvim: Theme-reload hook for an editor you may not use. Declaring it would make `deps status` report a missing dependency for everyone who does not run nvim.
undeclared.gdbus: Fallback path of the ghostty theme-reload hook, behind a SIGUSR2 attempt. Same reasoning as `nvim`.
undeclared.magick: Third choice in the wallpaper-thumbnail chain, behind Pillow and the already-declared `ffmpeg`.
undeclared.xclip: X11 clipboard fallback behind the declared `wl-copy`. Unreachable in a supported Hyprland/Niri session.
undeclared.g++: Compiles the vendored third_party/asdcontrol for Apple display brightness. The preferred Apple path is pure-Python hidraw and packaging can ship a prebuilt binary, so a compiler is not a dependency of the feature.
undeclared.c++: Alternative compiler name, same reasoning as `g++`.
undeclared.dolphin: Internal: picks a file manager for generated theme previews.
undeclared.nautilus: Deferred to VGS-32. Also a launcher folder opener, but declaring it now would entrench the hardcoded choice VGS-32 replaces with the XDG default-apps layer.
undeclared.yazi: Deferred to VGS-32. The launcher's Yazi opener needs `yazi` AND `xdg-terminal-exec`; declaring one half would misreport the gate.
undeclared.xdg-terminal-exec: Deferred to VGS-32, which centralises terminal resolution. Currently unowned by any landed change.
